officialTitle: Erlotinib versus standard chemotherapy as first-line treatment for European patients with advanced EGFR mutation-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (EURTAC): a multicentre, open-label, randomised phase 3 trial

design.notes: Stopped enrolment after preplanned interim analysis met the primary endpoint. Stratified by EGFR mutation type and ECOG PS.

clinicalQuestion: Does first-line erlotinib improve PFS over platinum-based chemotherapy in European patients with EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC?

pico.population: Adults with advanced NSCLC harbouring EGFR exon 19 deletion or L858R, no prior chemotherapy for metastatic disease, recruited in France, Italy and Spain
pico.comparator: Cisplatin (or carboplatin) plus docetaxel or gemcitabine

arms.label: Erlotinib
arms.doseSourceQuote: to receive oral erlotinib 150 mg per day

arms.label: Platinum doublet chemotherapy
arms.regimen: Cisplatin plus docetaxel or gemcitabine (carboplatin allowed)
arms.dosing: Cisplatin 75 mg/m² day 1 plus docetaxel 75 mg/m² day 1 or gemcitabine 1250 mg/m² days 1 and 8, every 3 weeks
arms.doseSourceQuote: 3 week cycles of standard intravenous chemotherapy of cisplatin 75 mg/m(2) on day 1 plus docetaxel (75 mg/m(2) on day 1) or gemcitabine (1250 mg/m(2) on days 1 and 8)

publications.title: Erlotinib versus standard chemotherapy as first-line treatment for European patients with advanced EGFR mutation-positive non-small-cell lung cancer (EURTAC): a multicentre, open-label, randomised phase 3 trial.
publications.label: Primary (interim) analysis

outcomes.sourceQuote: At data cutoff (Jan 26, 2011), median PFS was 9·7 months (95% CI 8·4-12·3) in the erlotinib group, compared with 5·2 months (4·5-5·8) in the standard chemotherapy group (hazard ratio 0·37, 95% CI 0·25-0·54; p < 0·0001).

safety.sourceQuote: Five (6%) patients on erlotinib had treatment-related severe adverse events compared with 16 patients (20%) on chemotherapy.
Main grade 3 or 4 toxicities were rash (11 [13%] of 84 patients given erlotinib vs none of 82 patients in the chemotherapy group)

strengths: First randomised phase III trial of a first-line EGFR TKI in a genotype-selected Western population
Prospective central EGFR testing as an eligibility criterion
limitations: Stopped early at interim analysis, which can overestimate effect size

clinicalImplications.text: Extended the evidence for first-line EGFR TKI therapy in EGFR-mutant NSCLC to a European population, supporting routine tissue EGFR testing at diagnosis.

tumourBoardPearl.text: EGFR-mutant benefit from first-line TKI is not an ethnicity effect — it is a genotype effect.

curation.notes: All numbers transcribed from the PubMed abstract of PMID 22285168.
